execution.method: public web fetch, read only, no contact and no form submission
execution.scope_followed: website assessment, trust signals, contact routes, visibility signals
scope_not_run: social media follower counts and last-post dates: not retrieved this pass
review platforms and Google Maps: not queried this pass
competitor context: not run this pass

findings.claim: The homepage publishes 5,000+ Projects Completed and 500+ Satisfied Clients, while the mission page publishes 500+ completed projects and 20+ corporate clients. The two owned pages disagree by an order of magnitude on projects and by 25x on clients.
findings.note: Both figures are genuinely published. The finding is the inconsistency itself, not a contradiction in our evidence, so it is one verified claim rather than two competing ones.

findings.claim: Coverage lists differ by page. The homepage names Surulere, Asaba, Port Harcourt, Ado Ekiti, Lagos and Abuja; the contact page adds Abeokuta, Delta and Ogun; the facility-management page names Lagos, Abuja, Abeokuta, Enugu and Port Harcourt, introducing Enugu and omitting Asaba, Ado Ekiti and Surulere.
The homepage states ISO Certified Services. No certificate number, issuing body, scope or expiry is published, and the mission page lists no certifications at all.
The SPOTA navigation item is labelled Coming Soon. It is a deliberate product teaser, not unfinished placeholder residue.
findings.note: This directly corrects the earlier engine research, which read the SPOTA text as stray placeholder residue beside the quote route.

findings.claim: The quote path is coherent: Get a Free Quote appears on every page fetched and resolves to /contact, three phone numbers and one email are published, office hours are stated, and a 24-hour tailored-quote response is committed.

Trust proof is substantial: 20-plus client logos including Dangote Group, Cummins and Providus Bank, three named testimonials with affiliations, three written case studies, and a full published address.
The contact page shows no visible form fields, no required-field markers and no confirmation state in the fetched content, although a Send Enquiry button and a Request a Quote section are referenced.
findings.limitation: A JavaScript-rendered form would not appear in a text fetch. This is an unresolved observation, not a verified defect.

findings.claim: No named individual appears on the homepage, the mission page, the contact page or the facility-management page. The /about path returns HTTP 404.

limitations: Social platforms were not opened. LinkedIn and Instagram links exist on the homepage but follower counts, last-post dates and content quality were not retrieved.
No review platform, Google Maps listing or press mention was queried.
Response-time and uptime commitments (24 hours, under 2 hours emergency, 99 percent uptime) are the company's own published claims. None was independently tested.
Mobile readiness, page speed and technical health were not measured and are not inferred here.
unknowns: Whether 5,000+ or 500+ is the accurate project figure.
Whether the ISO claim is current, and under which standard and scope.
Whether the enquiry form renders and confirms correctly for a real visitor.
Who owns the enquiry route internally.
assumptions_not_promoted_to_facts: That the numerical inconsistency costs enquiries. Plausible, untested, and not scored.
That the ISO claim is unsubstantiated rather than merely undocumented on the site.
That an absent form in a text fetch means an absent or broken form.
